Chapter 505: Chapter 8: Nine-Story Black Tower, Moyu Tower Master (Requesting Subscriptions)_2

Chapter 505: Chapter 8: Nine-Story Black Tower, Moyu Tower Master (Requesting Subscriptions)_2

…

Demon Jade Space.

Guided by the Magic Jade Mark, Lin Yuan passed through layers of heavy mist and finally arrived in front of a gigantic nine-floor black tower.

The nine-floor tower was grand and massive, entirely black, with a vaguely emanating aura that penetrated through several spatial layers.

“This tower?” Lin Yuan felt his spirit will under immense pressure,

The nine-floor tower matched the ‘Nine Floors Dark Tower’ from the Magic Jade Mark,

...

but the former was countless times larger than the latter and emitted a pressure so intense that Lin Yuan felt like he was facing the Xia Qin Supreme Being again.

“Comparable to the pressure of a Supreme Being, could this tower rival a Supreme Being?” Lin Yuan felt it was unbelievable.

In the Main World, Supreme Beings were the absolute synonyms for invincibility, dominating the vast Starry Sea.

While Lin Yuan kept examining the nine-floor tower.

A huge human-shaped stone statue slowly walked out.

“Little guy, don’t stare at the Black Tower for too long, it will have adverse effects on you,” the stone statue spoke.

Although Lin Yuan had never heard the language before, he somehow understood its meaning.

“I have seen the elder,” Lin Yuan immediately said humbly.

The giant stone statue that appeared outside the black tower, sharing the same aura as the tower, clearly played a guardian role.

It was likely greatly associated with the Demon Jade Tower, so it was only proper for Lin Yuan to respectfully address it as elder.

“Hahahahaha,” the stone statue laughed, “After so many years, to finally see a member of the Demon Jade Tower, at last someone to talk to.”

“Hmm?” Lin Yuan murmured, his mind slightly stirred.

From the stone statue’s statement, he could infer a lot of information.

For example, before Lin Yuan, the last member who had entered the Demon Jade Space must have been very long ago.

That is to say.

Currently, neither human civilization nor other peak different species had any clan members become ordinary members of the Demon Jade Tower.

Although it might be possible for some to become ordinary members whose strength had not yet reached the Eighth Rank peak, hence afraid to enter the Demon Jade Space,

the probability was too small; not everyone possessed Against-Heaven’s Understanding like Lin Yuan.

“My name is Shen Ji, little fellow, you can just call me by my name,” the stone statue said smilingly, also examining Lin Yuan closely.

“Eh? Did you become a regular member of the Demon Jade Tower by mastering over three thousand three hundred and thirty-three Demonic Evolution Paths? Your understanding is quite impressive…”

Stone Statue Shen Ji’s tone was tinged with surprise, as mastering over three thousand three hundred and thirty-three Demonic Evolution Paths was no easy feat, requiring much more time than perfecting a single Demonic Evolution Path.

Unless one had exceptional understanding, few beings chose this way to join the Demon Jade Tower.

Similarly, such ordinary members were more valued by the Demon Jade Tower than those who perfected a certain Demonic Evolution Path.

“Just by luck…” Lin Yuan immediately responded.

He simply felt that directly cultivating the Evolution Paths he had realized was too dangerous, and mastering multiple Evolution Paths could also enhance his foundation.

“All right, if you have any questions, feel free to ask me,” Stone Statue Shen Ji said.

He was quite pleased with Lin Yuan, primarily because after so many years, having a practitioner come along, he could have a conversation to relieve his boredom.

Moreover, Lin Yuan’s understanding was impressive; no matter how much time it took, a million or even ten million years, as long as he could comprehend all three thousand three hundred and thirty-three Demonic Evolution Paths, there was no question about his understanding.

If his understanding was lacking, no amount of time would allow him to comprehend so many Demonic Evolution Paths.

“Elder Shen Ji,” Lin Yuan thought for a moment before asking, “What about this trial, how should it be undergone?”

Lin Yuan had only gathered simple information about entering the Demon Jade Space and undergoing the trial to obtain corresponding rewards from his Magic Jade Mark,

but as for how to undergo the trial or what rewards to receive, he was not very clear.

“It’s simple,”

“See this nine-floor tower?” Stone Statue Shen Ji showed no impatience, explaining, “You can receive a great reward left by the Demonic Jade Tower Master for every layer you conquer.”

“A reward left by the Demonic Jade Tower Master?” Lin Yuan’s mind stirred.

“The higher the floor, the greater the reward,” the stone statue added, “But don’t get ahead of yourself, normally for beings with rank as high as eight, just passing the first floor is almost impossible, and from the seventh floor onward, basically only Twelfth-Rank lifeforms can attempt it.”

“Twelfth Rank…” Lin Yuan’s heart skipped a beat.

In the Main World Universe, Twelfth Rank has many names.

The ultimate being.

Or the Supreme Being.

And according to the meaning of the Stone Statue Shen Ji, even a Supreme Being only hopes to pass through the Seventh Layer, there is still the Eighth Layer and the Ninth Layer afterward.

“What specific rewards are there?” Lin Yuan was curious in his heart.

“That I do not know, the rewards left by the master are confidential, even I am not aware of them,” Stone Statue Shen Ji patiently said.

For countless millennia, he had been so lonely that now, faced with a little Eighth Layer fellow, he almost answered any question asked.

…

The grandiose entrance to the Nine Floors Dark Tower.

Stone Statue Shen Ji brought Lin Yuan here.

Further ahead, they would enter the range of the first layer of the Nine Floors Dark Tower.

“Little guy, just keep walking straight ahead to that black staircase, once you reach there, you would have passed the first layer, and what follows is the Second Layer,” Stone Statue Shen Ji spoke.

The entrance to the Nine Floors Dark Tower was hundreds of miles wide, Lin Yuan looked around, turned and asked Shen Ji, “Senior Shen Ji, what strength is required to pass the first layer?”

“Generally speaking, only a Ninth-Rank life has hope to pass through the first layer. As for Eighth-Rank life? It’s also possible if one grasps the Complete Space Rules,” Stone Statue Shen Ji spoke gently.

In his opinion, Lin Yuan had no hope of passing through the first layer, but as long as someone could keep him company to chat, that was enough.

Lin Yuan is an ordinary member of the Demon Jade Tower, holding the Magic Jade Mark, able to enter the Demon Jade Space at any time.

“Grasping the Complete Space Rules?”

Lin Yuan was secretly shocked.

For an Eighth-Rank life to grasp the Complete Space Rules… that was much more difficult than becoming an invincible at Eighth Layer.

In the Main World Universe Starry Sky, the number of invincibles at Eighth Layer is still some, human civilization, other great peak clans, even powerful clans, ordinary clans.

They all have invincibles at the Eighth Layer.

But for the Eighth Layer to grasp the Complete Space Rules?

It has indeed occurred.

But only through the long ages might such a person luckily be born.

…

“Of course, if you have deduced some kind of Cosmic Force, and this Cosmic Force is strong enough, there’s also hope of passing through the first layer,” Stone Statue Shen Ji added.

By implication, ordinary Cosmic Force stands no chance in passing through the first layer.

“That’s good,” Lin Yuan said, feeling a bit of relief in his heart.

If nothing else, he had plenty of Cosmic Force.

Actually, during his eighth traversal, in his stay of nine hundred and twenty years in the Spirit Realm.

If Lin Yuan hadn’t spent a lot of time on comprehending the Power of Creation.

He would probably have been able to grasp seven thousand seven hundred eighty-two core spatial models, mastering the Complete Space Rules.

But Lin Yuan never regretted his decision, Complete Space Rules? With Lin Yuan’s understanding, as long as he had enough time, he would be able to grasp it.

But the Power of Creation? Once out of the Spirit Realm, Lin Yuan couldn’t think of the next time he would encounter such a world with no limits on Cosmic Force, it could take who knows how long.

“Go ahead,” Stone Statue Shen Ji stood at the entrance and said.

“Okay,” Lin Yuan did not hesitate and directly entered the first layer of the Nine Floors Dark Tower.

Stone Statue Shen Ji watched Lin Yuan enter the Black Tower.

“Don’t know how long he can last, but just being able to deduce three thousand three hundred and thirty-three paths of evolutionary Dao to join the Demon Jade Pavilion, even with only Eighth Layer, there is hope of passing through the first layer,” Stone Statue Shen Ji thought to himself, as the scene of the first layer of the Black Tower appeared in front of him.

As the guardian of the Nine Floors Dark Tower, Stone Statue Shen Ji had many rights to prevent the Demon Jade Tower’s ordinary members from ‘cheating’ during their training.

Such as using ‘external force’ and so on,

The master of the Demon Jade Tower created this space to cultivate members,

If they used external force, it would lose the effect of the training, they would be driven out by Stone Statue Shen Ji, never to enter again.
